speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malignant Ovarian Tumor with Malignant Ascites.

The combination of a large ovarian mass, significant abdominal girth (ascites), and shortness of breath caused by diaphragmatic compression, in the absence of urinary issues or weight loss, strongly points to this diagnosis.
